justification: Any single pixel > 30° at 25m resolution = genuine cliff. 30° catches real untraversable features only.
reference: LOLA 25m terrain analysis; VIPER mobility model

justification: > 10% of region pixels above 25° = substantial impassable zone inside region even if mean slope looks acceptable.
reference: Derived from terrain mechanics at 25m pixel scale

justification: More than 50% of region permanently shadowed = rover cannot sustain solar power regardless of sun angle or season. Mazarico et al. 2011 JGR: PSR = illumination < 0.001/yr. Replaces LROC shadow_fraction gate per supervisor instruction.
At 50% coverage half the terrain is unmeasured. 80% ensures only small LOLA gaps remain.
reference: Deep research report; Mars rover landing site precedent

justification: Elevation std over 175m kernel. 10m = mesoscale undulation flag. UNCERTAIN not hard remove -- roughness is a gradient.
reference: Rosenburg et al. 2011 JGR; Barker et al. 2025 PSJ
